name: voice-wayfinder-workspace
description: Workspace for the voice-wayfinder Claude Code plugin: realtime voice bridge, Wayfinder voice rules and map mod.

scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:audio
scripts.build:bridge: esbuild bridge/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=plugin/server/bridge.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate plugin && claude plugin validate .
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate && npm run test:mod
